item.title: The Day The Future Ended: The Short Doc Exploring How Jim Henson’s Death Changed Entertainment Forever
item.description: On May 16, 1990, the entertainment world was rocked by news that felt impossible. Jim Henson was gone at just 53 years old. For a generation raised on felt, foam, and fearless imagination, it felt personal. For Hollywood, it felt like the rug had been pulled out from under the future.This short film documentary The Day the Future Ended takes a hard look at that moment and the creative earthquake that followed.
